description: This file defines a React functional component named Goals that allows users to view and update their nutritional goals such as calories, protein, carbs, and fat. It manages form state, handles input changes and form submissions, and displays confirmation messages upon updates.

methods.name: Goals()
methods.description: React functional component rendering a form for updating user nutritional goals, managing local form state, and interacting with application context to persist changes.

methods.name: handleChange(e)
methods.description: Handles input value changes, updating the form state with the new value for the changed field.

methods.name: handleSubmit(e)
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating goals via context, showing a confirmation message, and resetting the message after a delay.
